title: PlanInput
description: The complete input of one solve: data, scenarios and options. Its input_hash is sha256 over the canonical JSON of this document (see README). Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by every v1 adapter: ids unique within cards, cash_accounts, events, scenarios and pools; at most one snapshot per cash account; every cash account in the request currency; every cash_account_id / repay_from_cash_account_id names a cash account; includes_event_ids name events of the snapshot's own account dated on or before its as_of; an event's 'at' falls on its 'on' (in the timestamp's own offset); cards sharing a credit_account_id report the same raw_available_minor and the same pool_id; event_overrides name existing events, each at most once per scenario; posting_delay_min_days <= posting_delay_max_days.

cards.description: Candidate cards; order is the order of allocation lines and rejections. At most 200 (supported range).

snapshots.description: A cash account without a snapshot makes the run NEEDS_DATA (MISSING_SNAPSHOT).

horizon_end.description: Last date of the cash timeline, never extended (engine-spec §12.7): only the input decides what is checked. A card whose repayment would fall after it is excluded (REPAY_AFTER_HORIZON); the API sets it to at least txn_date + 180 days.
